name: asfai-learning
description: Plan lessons, design evaluations, transform teaching assets, and teach with ASFAI through one remote MCP connector.

interface.shortDescription: ASFAI lessons, evaluations, asset transformations, and private learning data.
interface.longDescription: Plan lessons, design evaluations, transform teaching assets, and teach through chat using the ASFAI learning graph. Connect PrivateDataPod and other Solid Pods, and exchange work with configurable classroom providers through one authenticated remote MCP connector. A connected Pod is the primary learning-record store. Pod and Google Classroom authorization is encrypted, isolated to the user's connector, and restored across devices using that connection until explicit removal or provider revocation.
defaultPrompt: Connect my private Pod and continue my lesson.
Help me learn a concept and save my progress.
Create a lesson outline for my course.
Design an evaluation from my lesson plan.
Transform my lesson notes into teaching slides.
